# Mahdi Khrrousheh

Mahdi Khrrousheh is an AI software engineer and backend engineer based in Ramallah.

## Primary Expertise

- AI agent pipelines and LLM workflow orchestration
- Structured output validation with schemas and Pydantic
- Python backend systems with FastAPI, Django REST Framework, and Flask
- Retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, and hallucination mitigation
- Cloud systems across AWS, GCP, Azure, Firebase, Docker, and CI/CD
- Full-stack product work with React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, and ShadCN

## Notable Projects

- AI Resume Processing Agents: two-stage resume parsing and profile conversion pipeline with prompt constraints and Pydantic validation.
- AI Psychological Companion: CBT-grounded MVP using FastAPI, LangChain, LangSmith, Pydantic, Gemini/LLM APIs, and planned RAG grounding.
- AidNexus First-Aid Assistant: Gemini and GCP based assistant for contextual first-aid guidance with structured prompt control.
